overview_description.description: The Middle Frame is building the leading generative AI platform for authentic Arab visuals. We license high-quality image and video datasets from the MENA region to power AI systems with culturally accurate content. Backed by a growing network of regional creators, we’re on a mission to make diverse, underrepresented visuals accessible to global AI and media platforms.
